usage: vibe wikify [-h]
                   {init,plan,verify,mark,reanchor,migrate-imported,fix-links,sync,install-hook,check,link,docs,adopt} ...

positional arguments:
  {init,plan,verify,mark,reanchor,migrate-imported,fix-links,sync,install-hook,check,link,docs,adopt}
    init                Scaffold docs/wiki (never overwrites files)
    plan                Show which wiki pages need updating
    verify              Check citations and scan the wiki for secrets
    mark                Verify, then record the covered commit
    reanchor            Fix line numbers of moved citations (dry run unless
                        --apply)
    migrate-imported    Register adopted docs as imported pages (dry run
                        unless --apply)
    fix-links           Rewrite dead paths in imported pages that .wikifymap
                        maps (dry run unless --apply)
    sync                Check for drift, preview re-anchoring and print the
                        work list (read-only)
    install-hook        Install a pre-push git hook that runs check --ci (dry
                        run unless --apply)
    check               Report which wiki pages drifted from the code (read-
                        only)
    link                Add the wiki pointer block to AGENTS.md (and
                        CLAUDE.md/GEMINI.md if present)
    docs                Write outline pages for existing markdown docs
    adopt               Move existing markdown docs into docs/wiki (dry run
                        unless --apply)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
